applicabilityBasis.summary: thUSD is marketed as a USD-pegged payment and transfer token, with yield confined to the separate sthUSD wrapper, supporting an apparent-payment-stablecoin watch classification. Direct redemption is disclosed only in USDC/USDT: GENIUS section 2(22)(A)(ii)(I) excludes a digital asset denominated in fixed monetary value from its monetary-value redemption test, so these disclosures alone do not establish definitive statutory inclusion.

genius.notes: Theo Protocol Corporation and its Panama address are named in the opened platform terms and corroborated by the Bloomberg LEI record, which establishes no financial authorization. Preserve the existing issuerEntity string unchanged. The terms state that the company, platform and services are not registered or licensed by a governmental or regulatory authority. No qualifying public Theo/thUSD approval, application, state qualification, foreign registration or GENIUS pathway statement was identified in the bounded regulator-directory and issuer-source review on 2026-10-07. The issuer pathway and foreign exception remain unknown. The transparency dashboard was retrieved through the web reader using its Jina fallback and displays Theo Protocol Corp attested 2026-06-22, Libeara thBILL holdings attested 2026-06-01, and Accountable auditor engagement in progress. These labels do not establish a monthly aggregate independent reserve attestation. The apparent-payment-stablecoin label remains an implementation-watch assessment rather than definitive statutory inclusion because disclosed direct redemption is only in USDC/USDT. The September Federal Reserve source is a proposal, not issuer authorization; the GENIUS regime remains pre-effective.
